## Comparing average amount of calories

```{r}
library(tidyverse)   # For data manipulation and visualization
library(ggrepel)     # ggplot extension for improved text labels
library(ggthemes)    # ggplot extension for additional themes
library(dplyr) 

df_selected <- data |> 
  select(Age, Gender,
         `Weight (kg)`, 
         `Height (m)`, 
         Calories_Burned, 
         Workout_Type, 
         BMI, 
         Fat_Percentage)


df_mutated <- df_selected |> 
  mutate(BMI_Category = case_when(
    BMI < 18.5 ~ "Underweight",
    BMI < 25 ~ "Normal",
    BMI < 30 ~ "Overweight",
    TRUE ~ "Obese"
  ))


df_filtered <- df_mutated |>
  filter(Age >= 18)

 
distinct_workouts <- df_filtered |> 
  select(Workout_Type) |> 
  distinct()

 
summary_df <- df_filtered |>
  group_by(Gender, Workout_Type) |> 
  summarize(
    mean_calories = mean(Calories_Burned, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_BMI = mean(BMI, na.rm = TRUE),
    count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

 
pivoted_df <- summary_df |> 
  select(Gender, Workout_Type, mean_calories) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Gender, values_from = mean_calories)


diff_df <- pivoted_df |> 
  mutate(difference = Male - Female)

summary_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Workout_Type, y = mean_calories, color = Workout_Type)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender, ncol = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Calories Burned by Workout Type and Gender",
    x = "Workout Type",
    y = "Average Calories Burned"
  )


```

> **The difference between amount of each gender**

```{r}










 #Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)   # For data manipulation and visualization
library(ggrepel)     # ggplot extension for improved text labels
library(ggthemes)    # ggplot extension for additional themes
library(dplyr)
# Load the data from the CSV URL
data<- read_csv("C:\\Users\\mikey\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\data 309\\DATA SETS\\Final_data.csv")


df_selected <- data |> 
  select(Age, Gender,
         `Weight (kg)`, 
         `Height (m)`, 
         Calories_Burned, 
         Workout_Type, 
         BMI, 
         Fat_Percentage)


df_mutated <- df_selected |> 
  mutate(BMI_Category = case_when(
    BMI < 18.5 ~ "Underweight",
    BMI < 25 ~ "Normal",
    BMI < 30 ~ "Overweight",
    TRUE ~ "Obese"
  ))


df_filtered <- df_mutated |>
  filter(Age >= 18)

 
distinct_workouts <- df_filtered |> 
  select(Workout_Type) |> 
  distinct()

 
summary_df <- df_filtered |>
  group_by(Gender, Workout_Type) |> 
  summarize(
    mean_calories = mean(Calories_Burned, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_BMI = mean(BMI, na.rm = TRUE),
    count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

 
pivoted_df <- summary_df |> 
  select(Gender, Workout_Type, mean_calories) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Gender, values_from = mean_calories)


diff_df <- pivoted_df |> 
  mutate(difference = Male - Female)


# Divergent bar graph using ggplot2
# Bars show difference in mean calories (Male - Female)
# Uses ggrepel for non-overlapping labels (ggplot extension)
ggplot(diff_df, aes(x = reorder(Workout_Type, difference), y = difference, fill = difference > 0)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = round(difference, 2)), 
                   direction = "y", 
                   size = 3, 
                   fill = "white") +  # Using geom_label_repel from ggrepel for better annotation
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "blue", "FALSE" = "pink"), guide = FALSE) +  # scale_fill_manual for custom colors
  coord_flip() +  # Flip coordinates for horizontal (divergent) bars
  labs(
    title = "Difference in Average Calories Burned by Gender and Workout Type",
    subtitle = "Positive: Males higher | Negative: Females higher",
    caption = "Data from Final_data.csv | Descriptive means used for comparison",
    x = "Workout Type",  # Custom axis labels
    y = "Calories Difference (Male - Female)"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +  # scale_y_continuous for formatted labels
  theme_minimal()
```
